lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four primary horizontal rows of circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid. The nodes are most distinct between the gill slits and the vertical axis of the first dorsal fin, showing relatively uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs. Each intersection point serves as a locus for a primary high-luminance circular feature, creating a discernible matrix pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper lateral flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient characterized by high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow transition on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a non-uniform distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration observed near the leading edge and base of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the right pectoral fin. A linear white feature, indicative of a superficial scar, is visible on the dorsal surface anterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Detection of three symbiotic organisms (remoras): two small individuals near the cranial region and one larger individual attached at the ventral-proximal junction of the right pectoral fin.
